name: bugfix
description: Fix a real security bug in existing code and add regression tests. The SSRF filter accepts decimal/hex/octal IP encodings of 127.0.0.1. Shows: brownfield bug fix, regression tests written from the bug report (not from the fix), existing safety tests re-proven, security review, release sign-off.
requirement: Bug fix (security): the SSRF protection can be bypassed with alternative IP encodings. http://2130706433/ (decimal), http://0x7f000001/ (hex) and http://0177.0.0.1/ (octal) are accepted, but browsers and HTTP clients send them to 127.0.0.1. Reject non-canonical IP notation and add regression tests.

script.comment: Reject non-canonical numeric hosts; keep canonical dotted-decimal.
